caption:
Hybi's Weekly Recap for Nov 2–7 is here.

During exercise, pain up to 3/10 that settles overnight is usually fine to carry on with. For persistent pain, start a little below what you can manage on a bad day and add about 10% every 1–2 weeks. Lifting? Practise the hip hinge: soften the knees and push the hips back. And at your desk, set your chair so your knees sit about hip level.
